title: Web search in Microsoft Copilot: what leaves the tenant, and who can switch it off?
summary: Hold: leaving the commercial web-search policy unset does not always allow searches, because the optional connected-experiences policy can disable them. Domain exclusions filter returned web pages rather than what is sent to Bing, and the Graph control needs its government-cloud restriction stated.

claims.claim: Web search is an optional feature that lets Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft Copilot Chat reference web content in answers.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft Copilot Chat have an optional feature that allows Copilot to reference web content when responding to user prompts.

claims.claim: When enabled, web search may retrieve information from Bing to ground a response.
claims.quote: When web search is enabled, Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft Copilot Chat may fetch information from the Bing search service when information from the web helps to provide a better, more grounded response.

claims.where: What it is: How a search is made
claims.claim: Copilot parses the prompt and identifies terms where web information would improve the response.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft Copilot Chat parse the user's prompt and identifies terms where information from the web would improve the quality of the response.

claims.where: What it is: How a search is made; summary
claims.claim: Copilot generates a query consisting of a few words and sends it to Bing.
claims.quote: Copilot generates a search query that it sends to the Bing search service asking for more information. This generated search query is different from the user's original prompt-it consists of a few words informed by the user's prompt.

claims.where: What it is: How a search is made
claims.claim: The generated query does not include the entire prompt unless the prompt is very short.
claims.quote: The following information isn't included in the generated search query sent to the Bing search service: The user's entire prompt, unless the prompt is very short (for example, "local weather")

claims.where: What it is: How a search is made
claims.claim: The query does not include entire Microsoft 365 files.
claims.quote: The following information isn't included in the generated search query sent to the Bing search service: Entire Microsoft 365 files (for example, emails or documents) or files uploaded into Copilot

claims.where: What it is: How a search is made
claims.claim: Identifying information based on the user's Microsoft Entra ID is excluded from generated queries.
claims.quote: Generated search queries are sent to the Bing search service with identifying information based on the user's Microsoft Entra ID removed (for example, username, domain, or tenant ID).

claims.where: What it is: How a search is made
claims.claim: Copilot sends the user's client IP address to Bing.
claims.quote: When Copilot sends a web search request to the Bing search service, it also sends the user's client IP address, which Bing uses to help localize results, such as nearby weather and events.

claims.claim: In Microsoft Copilot, a query may be informed by a document open in the Microsoft 365 app where the user prompts.
claims.quote: When a user enters a prompt into Copilot inside a Microsoft 365 application (for example, writing a prompt into Copilot in Microsoft Word while a relevant document is open).

claims.claim: A Microsoft Copilot query may be informed by a Microsoft 365 document explicitly referenced in the prompt.
claims.quote: However, it may also be informed by data within a Microsoft 365 document under the following conditions: When the user explicitly references a specific document in their prompt.

claims.claim: The described invocation of organizational documents distinguishes Microsoft Copilot from Copilot Chat.
claims.quote: Unlike with Microsoft Copilot, users can't invoke organizational content like files, emails, or chats, when prompting in Microsoft Copilot Chat.

claims.quote: The information about web search in this article also applies to Researcher, Analyst, and Cowork in Microsoft Copilot.

claims.claim: Microsoft Copilot Search is a separate universal search experience across Microsoft 365 and third-party data.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot Search is an additional, universal search experience that allows users with a Microsoft Copilot license to search across all their Microsoft 365 and third-party data sources.

claims.claim: The described Microsoft Copilot Search experience is for users with a Microsoft Copilot licence.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot Search is an additional, universal search experience that allows users with a Microsoft Copilot license to search across all their Microsoft 365 and third-party data sources.

claims.claim: Generated queries leave Microsoft 365 for Bing, which operates separately with different data handling.
claims.quote: The Bing search service operates separately from Microsoft 365 and has different data-handling practices. The web search queries generated by Copilot and sent to Bing are subject to the Microsoft Services Agreement

claims.claim: The Data Protection Addendum does not apply to generated web-search queries.
claims.quote: The Microsoft Products and Services Data Protection Addendum (DPA) doesn't apply to the use of generated web search queries in Microsoft Copilot, Microsoft Copilot Chat, or the Bing search service.

claims.claim: HIPAA compliance does not apply to generated queries.
claims.quote: Also, HIPAA compliance and the EU Data Boundary don't apply to generated search queries.

claims.claim: The EU Data Boundary does not apply to generated queries.
claims.quote: Also, HIPAA compliance and the EU Data Boundary don't apply to generated search queries.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risks and limits: Unset means on
claims.claim: An unconfigured Allow web search in Copilot policy always leaves web search available in commercial tenants.
claims.quote: web search will be available to users in both Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft Copilot Chat, unless the IT admin has set the Allow the use of additional optional connected experiences in Office policy to Disabled.
claims.fix: In Why it matters and the Unset means on bullet, replace the unconditional default with: 'In commercial tenants, an unconfigured Allow web search in Copilot policy leaves web search available unless Allow the use of additional optional connected experiences in Office is Disabled.' Replace 'Leaving it unset is therefore a decision to allow it' with 'Check both policies before treating an unset web-search policy as permission to search.'

claims.where: Why it matters; What to check
claims.claim: GCC web search is off by default and remains off until the web-search policy is configured.
claims.quote: For United States government customers using Microsoft 365 (or Office 365) Government Community Cloud (GCC) or DoD offerings: Web search is available, but is turned off by default.

claims.where: Why it matters; What to check
claims.claim: DoD web search remains off if Allow web search in Copilot is unconfigured.
claims.quote: If you don't configure the Allow web search in Copilot policy, web search remains turned off, regardless of how the Allow the use of additional optional connected experiences in Office policy is configured.

claims.claim: Allow web search in Copilot controls access for Copilot and Copilot Chat users or groups across a tenant.
claims.quote: This policy allows IT admins to either turn on or turn off web search for users or user groups across the tenant they manage

claims.claim: Domain exclusions govern sites used for Copilot and Copilot Chat web grounding.
claims.quote: By using domain exclusion, you can specify up to 1,000 sites to exclude from web grounding in Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Chat through a PowerShell script.

claims.claim: DLP can prevent Copilot web search when a prompt contains selected sensitive information types.
claims.quote: When a user prompt contains the configured SITs, Copilot and Cowork block external web search as a grounding source and continue to generate the response using allowed internal Microsoft 365 data sources.

claims.claim: The domain exclusion list is one of three layers that narrow what is sent outside Microsoft 365.
claims.quote: Currently, domain exclusions support filtering on web page results only. Results from other answer verticals, such as news, might still be cited.
claims.fix: Replace 'Three layers then narrow what is sent: the admin policy, the per-prompt DLP rule and the domain exclusion list. They do different jobs and none replaces another.' with 'The admin policy controls whether web search is allowed; DLP can block web search for a sensitive prompt; domain exclusions filter returned web page results rather than the query sent to Bing.'

claims.claim: Admin controls and the user Web content toggle are available to eligible Copilot and Copilot Chat users.
claims.quote: Admin controls and a user-level Web content toggle are available for eligible Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft Copilot Chat users.

claims.quote: Use the Copilot License Details diagnostic to check whether a user account meets applicable licensing requirements for Copilot features.

claims.claim: Cloud Policy supports most Microsoft 365 subscription plans that include Microsoft 365 Apps.
claims.quote: Cloud Policy supports most Microsoft 365 subscription plans that include Microsoft 365 Apps. Check your licensing documentation for specific requirements.

claims.claim: Cloud Policy does not support Microsoft 365 operated by 21Vianet.
claims.quote: The following plans are not supported: Microsoft 365 operated by 21Vianet

claims.claim: Disabling additional optional connected experiences restricts web search when its own policy is unconfigured.
claims.quote: web search will be available to users in both Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft Copilot Chat, unless the IT admin has set the Allow the use of additional optional connected experiences in Office policy to Disabled.

claims.claim: Disabling optional connected experiences also restricts multiple other Microsoft 365 experiences.
claims.quote: But turning off optional connected experiences restricts Microsoft Copilot Chat, Microsoft Copilot, and multiple experiences across Microsoft 365.

claims.claim: The user's optional connected-experiences privacy setting has no effect on web-search availability.
claims.quote: The privacy setting for optional connected experiences available to users in Microsoft 365 apps (for example, in Word, Excel, or Teams) has no effect on the availability of web search.

claims.where: Risks and limits: Users can only narrow; controls[3]
claims.claim: Users can turn web content off when administrators allow web search.
claims.quote: If the IT admin turns on web search for Microsoft Copilot users, those users still have the option to turn off web search by using the Web content toggle.

claims.claim: An admin-disabled Web content toggle appears dimmed.
claims.quote: If the IT admin turns off web search, the Web content toggle is turned off and appears dimmed. / If the IT admin disables web search, the Web content toggle isn't available to the user and web search is disabled.
claims.fix: Replace assertions that the toggle is necessarily dimmed with: 'Microsoft describes the admin-disabled toggle as dimmed in its IT admin section and unavailable in its user-toggle section.' In What to check, use 'confirm users cannot enable web search when the admin disables it'.

claims.where: Risks and limits: Users can only narrow; controls[3].note
claims.claim: Users cannot turn web search on when administrators disable it.
claims.quote: Users can't turn on the toggle to use web search.

claims.where: Risks and limits: Option three; What to check
claims.claim: The policy offers three options.
claims.quote: If the IT admin enables the Allow web search in Copilot policy, they have three options for web search in Copilot:

claims.claim: The option Disabled in Microsoft Copilot Work mode; Enabled in Microsoft Copilot Web mode and Microsoft Copilot Chat disables Researcher web search.
claims.quote: If the IT admin chooses the Disabled in Microsoft Copilot Work mode; Enabled in Microsoft Copilot Web mode and Microsoft Copilot Chat option, web search in Researcher and Cowork in Microsoft Copilot will be disabled.

claims.quote: If the IT admin chooses the Disabled in Microsoft Copilot Work mode; Enabled in Microsoft Copilot Web mode and Microsoft Copilot Chat option, web search in Researcher and Cowork in Microsoft Copilot will be disabled.
